# Excel experiments E1 to E13

Small authored workbooks, one question each, for the xlsx design's Phase 0
experiments (`docs/design.md`, xlsx). They are generated by
`internal/xlsx/experiments_test.go`, which also records their provenance
(the layout follows an Excel 16 workbook from the corpus); regenerate with
`XLSX_EXPERIMENTS_UPDATE=1 go test ./internal/xlsx -run TestExperimentFixtures`.

How to run: the maintainer opens each file in Excel, by hand or with
`make excel-smoke` (which force-quits Excel; the maintainer approves every
run), notes what this table asks, then closes **without saving** unless the
line says otherwise. Record the answers, with the Excel version, in the
Excel experiments table of `docs/design.md`.

Every sheet's inputs are in column A; A1=2 and A2=3 where a formula needs
numbers.

| File | What to look for |
| --- | --- |
| `e1-formula-no-value.xlsx` | E1, no recalculation flag. A3 is `=A1+A2` with no stored value. Repair prompt? Does A3 show 5, 0 or blank on open (before any edit)? Does Excel ask to save on close? |
| `e1-formula-no-value-fullcalc.xlsx` | E1 with `fullCalcOnLoad`. Same formula. Repair prompt? A3 should show 5. Does Excel ask to save on close (it is expected to)? If you save a copy, is `fullCalcOnLoad` gone from it? |
| `e2-calcchain-stale.xlsx` | E2, stale chain. The calcChain lists A3 (a formula) and B1 (a plain 7). Repair prompt (expected: yes)? Record the alert text exactly. |
| `e2-calcchain-removed.xlsx` | E2, chain removed. The same workbook with no calcChain part, relationship or override. Opens cleanly? A3 shows 5? |
| `e3-inline-strings.xlsx` | E3. A1 is a shared string ("Shared"); A2 to A5 are inline: `Inline`, `  padded  ` (two spaces each side kept), `tab<TAB>here` (a tab, from `_x0009_`), and the literal text `_x0041_` (escaped as `_x005F_x0041_`; it must not show `A`). Repair prompt? Each cell as described? Save a copy: does it open, and are the strings now shared? |
| `e4-sst-count-stale.xlsx` | E4. The shared strings declare count 1 and uniqueCount 1 but hold three strings, each used once (A1:A3 = one, two, three). Repair prompt? All three shown? |
| `e5-orphan-shared-formula.xlsx` | E5. B2 is a shared-formula child (`si="0"`) whose master is missing, with a stored 6. Repair prompt? If it opens, what does B2 show, and what formula does the formula bar give for it? |
| `e6-new-function-no-prefix.xlsx` | E6, with `fullCalcOnLoad`. A1="ab", A2="cd". A3 `CONCAT(A1,A2)` and A4 `TEXTJOIN("-",TRUE,A1:A2)` are written without `_xlfn.`; A5 is `_xlfn.CONCAT(A1,A2)`. Repair prompt? Do A3 and A4 compute (`abcd`, `ab-cd`) or show `#NAME?`? A5 should show `abcd`. |
| `e7-spill-plain.xlsx` | E7, with `fullCalcOnLoad`. A1 is `_xlfn.SEQUENCE(3)` and C1 `SEQUENCE(3)`, both plain cell formulas (no array, no spill metadata). Repair prompt? What do A1 and C1 show (1, a spill of 1 to 3 down the column, `#NAME?`)? Does the formula bar show `=@SEQUENCE(3)`? |
| `e8-blank.xlsx` | E8. The blank workbook `xlsx create` will start from: one empty sheet named Sheet1, styles, no theme, no shared strings, no document properties. Opens cleanly? Type a value, save a copy, reopen: clean? |
| `e9-edited.xlsx` | E9, edited with `fullCalcOnLoad` and no calcChain. A1 was changed from 2 to 7; A3 `=A1+A2` still caches 5 and A4 `=A3*10` still caches 50. Do A3/A4 show the stale 5/50 or recompute to 10/100? |
| `e9-edited-noflag.xlsx` | E9 without `fullCalcOnLoad`. Same stale dependents (A1=7, A3 caches 5, A4 caches 50). Same question. |
| `e10-mismatch.xlsx` | E10, mismatch. Table ref A1:B3 with tableColumns "Name" and "Qty", but header B1 is "Quantity". What column names does the reader report? |
| `e10-match.xlsx` | E10 control: header B1 is "Qty", matching the tableColumns. |
| `e11-mergecells.xlsx` | E11. An empty `<mergeCells count="0"/>` in the worksheet. Repair prompt? Opens? |
| `e11-hyperlinks.xlsx` | E11. An empty `<hyperlinks/>` (no hyperlink children). Repair prompt? |
| `e11-cf.xlsx` | E11. A `<conditionalFormatting sqref="">` holding one valid cellIs rule. Repair prompt? |
| `e11-dv.xlsx` | E11. An empty `<dataValidations count="0"/>`. Repair prompt? |
| `e11-definednames.xlsx` | E11. An empty `<definedNames/>` in workbook.xml. Repair prompt? |
| `e11-tableparts.xlsx` | E11. An empty `<tableParts count="0"/>` in the worksheet. Repair prompt? |
| `e12-stale-row-spans.xlsx` | E12. Row 1 declares `spans="1:2"` but holds cells A1:E1. Does the reader show five cells or two? |
| `e13-print-area-ref.xlsx` | E13. A `_xlnm.Print_Area` definedName (localSheetId 0) with value `Sheet1!#REF!`. What does the reader report for the print area? |
